items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I got to play at a session with Dizzy, yes, in New York.

ctx.x: Think of some of the most memorable gigs along the way. You’ve mentioned Dizzy. Did you get to play with Dizzy?
I got to play at a session with Dizzy, yes, in New York.
